name: packetcheck
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();R=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text());P=json.loads(Path('provenance.json').read_text());G=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(G)==set(map(str,R['ids']))
for p in P:
 b=Path('originals/'+str(p['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'] and b.endswith(b'\n');o=json.loads(b);assert len(p['statement_tokens'])==1
 t=p['statement_tokens'][0];assert json.loads(t['token'])==o['statement'];assert t['decoded']==o['statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(t['token'].encode()).hexdigest()==t['sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==t['decoded_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='0e0b6cd9795983f3d7c2ff94111e58ba1544269a32595f0c048710046b77d211'
records=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for b in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 r=json.loads(b);assert r['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert len([r for r in records if r['event']=='attempt'])==9
assert len([r for r in records if r['event']=='success'])==9
assert not [r for r in records if r['event']=='unavailable']
budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());cs=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert budget['calls_used']==len(cs)==3 and budget['queries_used']==sum(len(c['queries']) for c in cs)==9
for i in range(1,4): assert json.loads(Path('search-response-'+str(i)+'.json').read_text())
# Correct an overbroad retention phrase: bootstrap display truncation is documented,
# without asserting the bootstrap receipt contains its full stdout.
n='inventories.json';inv=json.loads(Path(n).read_text());inv['bootstrap_deviation']='Initial display oversized/truncated; all20 literals recovered in recover.output.txt; ancestor AGENTS displayed in bootstrap, TASK supplied in user and recovered in capped own reads. No assertion bootstrap-receipt embeds full stdout. Frozen-before standalone all13 matched.'
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=json.dumps(inv,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
report={'raw_token_decoded_bindings_verified':20,'reservation_hash_verified':True,'HTTP_attempts':9,'HTTP_successes':9,'HTTP_unavailable':0,'hashchain_verified':True,'search_calls':3,'search_queries':9,'all20_separate_gate_sets':True,'qualified':0,'no_frozen_mutations_authorized':True}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'packet-check.json'],input=json.dumps(report,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True);print(json.dumps(report))
